format: html
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: console
---

```{r}
## read in the R objects
out <- readRDS(file.path(LOCUS_DIR, 
                            "R_objects", "04_out.rds"))

out <- as.data.frame(out)

# Add the new column safely
if (LOCUS == 16) {
  out$sample_name <- sapply(rownames(out), get.sample.name.16s)
} else {
  out$sample_name <- sapply(rownames(out), get.sample.name)
}

dadaFs <- readRDS(file.path(LOCUS_DIR, 
                            "R_objects","06_dadaFs.rds"))
dadaRs <- readRDS(file.path(LOCUS_DIR, 
                            "R_objects", "06_dadaRs.rds"))
mergers	<- readRDS(file.path(LOCUS_DIR, 
                            "R_objects", "06_mergers.rds"))
seqtab.nochim <- readRDS(file.path(LOCUS_DIR, 
                            "R_objects", "06_seqtab.nochim.rds"))
filtFs <- readRDS(file.path(LOCUS_DIR, 
                            "R_objects", "04_fnFs.filtN.rds"))

fnFs.cut <- readRDS(file.path(LOCUS_DIR, "R_objects", "02_fnFs.cut.rds"))
fnRs.cut <- readRDS(file.path(LOCUS_DIR, "R_objects", "02_fnRs.cut.rds"))

track <- data.frame(
  sample = out$sample_name, 
  input = out[,1],
  filtered = out[,2],
  denoisedF = sapply(dadaFs, getN)[out$sample_name],
  denoisedR = sapply(dadaRs, getN)[out$sample_name],
  merged = sapply(mergers, getN)[out$sample_name],
  nonchim = rowSums(seqtab.nochim)[out$sample_name]
)

colnames(track) <- c("sample", "input", "filtered", 
                     "denoisedF", "denoisedR", "merged", "nochim")


write.table(track, file = file.path(LOCUS_DIR, 
                            "outputs",
                            paste0("07_", marker, "_track_reads_table.csv")))
```
